profile.headline: Software Engineer at HASELWOOD AUTO GROUP
profile.summary: My biggest passion in life has always been learning. During my teenage years, I developed an intense interest in studying languages, and this led me to study German, Spanish, Norwegian, and Chinese in college, in addition to a second degree in History. After graduating, I developed an interest in software development, which was largely self-taught until joining Amazon Technical Academy. This combination of independent study and formal training is indicative of how I approach problems: allowing my curiosity to guide me to new areas of interest while ensuring I have whatever formal background is necessary to do the job well.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and build MCP architecture in Python with fastmcp for self-hosted agentic assistants running on Ollama.
• Develop MCP connectors that give assistants access to data from RDS pipelines, REST APIs, and auto industry
systems.
• Architect connector boundaries so internal workflows can be automated without exposing sensitive PII or financial data.
• Own front-end and back-end web applications, APIs, data pipelines, and infrastructure end to end.
positions.insights: Software Infrastructure, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description: As part of the Royalties organization within Amazon Music, I've worked to build systems that aggregate large volumes of streaming data as well as vendor royalty contracts to automate generation and delivery of usage reports. Most recently my work has focused on integrating these work streams with Amazon's accounting ledgers and payment systems to automate financial reporting and timely payments to vendors.
positions.insights: AWS Lambda, Software Project Management and +25 skills

positions.title: Amazon Technical Academy Participant
positions.description:
Participated in the first cohort of Amazon Technical Academy, which seeks to train non-technical internal employees in software engineering and development.

Spent one year of classroom-based learning covering the following:
- Languages: C, Python, Java, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL
- Frameworks/Tools: AWS Tools (Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, etc.), Serverless, Git, Flask, Bootstrap
- 3 months of data structures & algorithms
- 3-month prerequisite course: Harvard CS50

In addition to classroom learning, worked on real-world projects including:
- Building multiple full-stack web applications using AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, & Bootstrap
- Building robust back-end services using internal Amazon frameworks.
- As a final project, helped build the back-end architecture for future iterations of Amazon Technical Academy

As part of the inaugural cohort, I also participated in numerous feedback discussions and meetings to help improve the program for future iterations.
positions.insights: AWS Lambda, Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) and +15 skills

positions.title: Catalog Specialist II
positions.description:
Analyze X-Ray coverage data and prioritize content to be covered each week.
Assign work to teammates and allocate team resources to ensure coverage goals for each week are met.
Oversee the application of Amazon's X-Ray for Instant Video product onto titles in Amazon's German-language catalog.
Translate various pieces of metadata from English-language assets into German.

positions.title: Family Room Specialist
positions.description:
Met with customers to troubleshoot issues on Macs, iPads, and iPhones. Performed repairs when necessary.

Also facilitated personal training sessions with customers on Macs, iPads, and iPhones.

positions.title: Specialist
positions.description:
Worked in sales and helped customers find the right products to meet their needs, then helped customers get their new products set up before leaving the store. Also facilitated group workshops to help customers learn more about their new products.

Worked with the visual merchandising team to maintain in-store demo devices and prepare store for new product launches and inventory changes.

volunteerExperiences.description: Traveled with doctors to remote villages in Nicaragua to provide medical services to residents. Worked in the mobile pharmacy as a translator and assisted doctors with communicating prescription instructions to patients.

projects.title: SF Train Times Alexa Skill
projects.description: Wrote an Alexa skill that provides real-time estimates of train arrivals at San Francisco Muni stops, using Python, AWS Lambda, and AWS DynamoDB
